notes: With Clipper (on your phone): Muni 2.75, cable car 9, BART to SFO 10. The hills are steep, so Muni Metro plus buses works well. Uber, Lyft and Waymo (driverless) are also available.
September to October is best (sunny, 22°C). Winter is 10-14°C with rain from December to February. The redwoods are good in every season; Chinatown's New Year celebrations are in February.
Book Alcatraz and Muir Woods weeks ahead. The Academy costs 45 USD and Alcatraz 45 USD. The 8.6% tax and 18-20% tip are not included in prices.
Try sourdough (Tartine, Boudin), the Mission burrito, cioppino, dim sum and Ferry Building oysters. For coffee, go to Blue Bottle or Ritual.
At night, avoid the Tenderloin (west of Union Square) and 6th Street in SoMa. Do not leave belongings in the car (window smashing). Homelessness is visible but the danger is low.
Follow Karl the Fog on Instagram. Go to Twin Peaks or Battery Spencer at sunset to see the fog dance.

transit.name: Clipper Card
transit.why_chosen: Valid on Muni, cable cars, BART and ferries; can be loaded onto your phone
transit.coverage: Muni otobüs/metro/cable car, BART, Golden Gate feribotu

days.theme: Union Square, Chinatown and cable cars

stops.name: Powell Street Cable Car
stops.tips: The Powell-Hyde line, a cable car running since 1873. At 08:30 there is no queue: hang off the outside and get off at Lombard.

stops.name: Lombard Street
stops.tips: The "crookedest street in the world" has 8 bends. Look down from Hyde.

stops.name: Chinatown Dragon Gate & Grant Avenue
stops.tips: The oldest Chinatown in North America. Visit the Golden Gate Fortune Cookie Factory (Ross Alley).

stops.name: Good Mong Kok Bakery
stops.tips: Cash only, dim sum in a box to go. The queue moves fast.

stops.name: Ferry Building Marketplace
stops.tips: A market in the 1898 ferry building: oysters (Hog Island), Blue Bottle, Acme sourdough. Farmers' market on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.

backups.name: Boudin Bakery Fisherman's Wharf
backups.tips: Sourdough since 1849. Clam chowder is served in a bread bowl.

backups.name: Exploratorium
backups.tips: Science museum at Pier 15. An alternative to the Embarcadero.

days.theme: Golden Gate by bike and Sausalito

stops.name: Crissy Field & Fort Point
stops.tips: Rent a bike at Fisherman's Wharf (40 USD/day). Ride the Presidio shoreline to the foot of the bridge, passing the Palace of Fine Arts on the way.

stops.name: Golden Gate Bridge
stops.tips: The bridge is 2.7 km long. Cross by bike (east sidewalk on weekdays). In summer the fog lasts until noon and it is windy.

stops.name: Sausalito
stops.tips: A Mediterranean feel beyond the bridge, with houseboats (Waldo Point).

stops.name: Fish Sausalito
stops.tips: Sustainable seafood by the harbour. Cash only.

stops.name: Sausalito Ferry
stops.tips: Take the Golden Gate Ferry back to the city (with your bike), with views of Alcatraz and the skyline.

backups.name: Golden Gate Welcome Center Vista Point
backups.tips: Without a bike: take the 28 bus to the bridge and walk.

stops.name: Alcatraz Island
stops.tips: Ferry from Pier 33 (Alcatraz City Cruises, 45 USD). The cell house audio tour is narrated by former inmates. Book tickets online weeks ahead; the first ferry leaves at 08:45.

stops.name: Pier 39 Sea Lions
stops.tips: Hundreds of sea lions on K-Dock. Touristy but fun.

stops.name: Tony's Pizza Napoletana
stops.tips: North Beach's world-champion pizza, near Washington Square.

stops.name: City Lights Bookstore
stops.tips: The Beat Generation bookshop (1953), next to Vesuvio bar.

stops.name: Coit Tower
stops.tips: A 1933 tower on Telegraph Hill. See frescoes by Diego Rivera's students, take the lift for the views, and look for parrots on the Filbert Steps.

backups.name: Mama's on Washington Square
backups.tips: North Beach brunch. Expect a queue.

backups.name: Musée Mécanique
backups.tips: Antique arcade machines at Pier 45. Free entry, an alternative to the sea lions.

stops.name: California Academy of Sciences
stops.tips: Living roof, rainforest dome, aquarium and planetarium, all in Golden Gate Park.

stops.name: Japanese Tea Garden
stops.tips: A tea garden from 1894 with a pagoda and bridge. Free early in the morning.

stops.name: Nopalito Haight
stops.tips: Sustainable Mexican food: carnitas, next to the park.

stops.name: Haight-Ashbury
stops.tips: The hippie corner of 1967. Visit Amoeba Music and vintage shops; the Painted Ladies at Alamo Square are 20 minutes away.

stops.name: Alamo Square Painted Ladies
stops.tips: Victorian houses against the skyline: the Full House shot.

backups.name: Conservatory of Flowers
backups.tips: A Victorian greenhouse. An alternative to the tea garden.

stops.name: Muir Woods National Monument
stops.tips: Coast redwoods up to 80 m tall. A parking or shuttle reservation is REQUIRED (gomuirwoods.com). Allow 45 minutes by tour or car; the main loop takes 1 hour.

stops.name: Muir Beach Overlook
stops.tips: Pacific cliff views and a World War II lookout.

stops.name: Pelican Inn Muir Beach
stops.tips: An English pub with fish and chips and a fireplace.

stops.name: Mill Valley
stops.tips: A redwood town. Visit the Depot bookstore on the square.

stops.name: Marin Headlands Battery Spencer
stops.tips: The best postcard view of the Golden Gate. Hawk Hill, and the dance of the fog.

backups.name: Stinson Beach
backups.tips: A long Pacific beach. In summer, a alternative to Mill Valley and the Headlands.

stops.name: Tartine Bakery
stops.tips: Legendary sourdough and morning bun. Queue at 08:00 on Guerrero; across the street is Mission Dolores, a church from 1776.

stops.name: Clarion Alley & Balmy Alley Murals
stops.tips: Latin street art. See the Women's Building mural; a Precita Eyes tour is optional.

stops.name: La Taqueria Mission
stops.tips: Award-winning Mission burrito (no rice). Cash only, with a queue.

stops.name: Dolores Park
stops.tips: A hilltop park with city views. Get Bi-Rite ice cream (queue) in the sunny neighbourhood.

stops.name: Castro Street & Castro Theatre
stops.tips: The LGBT neighbourhood: rainbow crosswalk, Harvey Milk, and a cinema from 1922.

backups.name: Bi-Rite Creamery
backups.tips: Salted caramel ice cream, next to the park.

backups.name: Twin Peaks
backups.tips: A 280 m city panorama. Take the 37 bus from Castro; it is windy.

stops.name: Palace of Fine Arts
stops.tips: A 1915 imitation Roman ruin with a pond and swans.

stops.name: Presidio Tunnel Tops
stops.tips: A new park with Golden Gate views and a playground, next to the Walt Disney Family Museum.

stops.name: Presidio Social Club
stops.tips: A restaurant in a former barracks. Brunch and a farewell.

stops.name: BART SFO
stops.tips: The airport is 30 minutes by BART (from Embarcadero). Goodbye.

backups.name: Walt Disney Family Museum
backups.tips: The Disney museum in the Presidio. An alternative to Tunnel Tops.
